reason: 869396f343 adds deps.sort_by_key(|a| a.source_order()) in code_splitter.rs; fix c9424469a3 changes only that line. Needs the trait default (None for non-ESM) in dependency_trait.rs:92, so a two-site fact.

aee14f8e02 adds disable_passes(CHUNK_IDS/MODULE_IDS) to the id plugins, but fix c8605359f3 is a 34-file change (preserved-ids refactor, new hook arg, 3 more plugins). I could not show that module hashes depended on module ids in the April 2025 tree. The omission is plausible at intro but unproven.

2eacc2bf03 adds protocol_relative_tag_src.starts_with(protocol_relative_public_path), which is true for '//host/..' when public_path is '/'; 619a1137e8 adds the is_local_public_path guard. Single function, local. I did not verify the downstream effect of the false match (integrity lookup).
3eb515347c iterates affected_dependencies.updated() in end_idle; 63d238941a switches to active(). Needs the mark_as_add writers in factorize.rs and process_dependencies.rs, a writer/reader pair.

37f633edaa deletes the call_member_chain handler (all rs.* calls) and moves importActual/requireActual to statement/declarator hooks; d4a3984886 restores a call_member_chain hook for just those two. Needs the parser hook-coverage contract.

The empty-referenced_exports path is the same before and after cf728c9ee7: the old get_referenced_exports already returned Export(names) unchanged, and the intro only adds the '*' branch (+13 lines, mostly tests). Fix 814145bf50 adds the is_empty() branch. The defect predates the intro commit.

ed72c93deb adds readable_identifier_getter calling module.readable_identifier(module.get_context()); fix c3e3de05a6 passes compilation.options.context. Needs the callee contract on what 'context' means.
c7f428bd21 adds (start, end - 1) in process_import_meta_resolve_item; a5bf6046f2 changes it to param.range().into(). Needs the range convention used by the dependency template's source.replace.

ddc06d2f6d adds chunk_group.chunks.first() plus chunk.name() in manifest process_assets; e8bd11c767 replaces it with name-candidate matching. Needs the fact that chunk groups can hold several chunks, a producer/consumer fact across the splitter and this plugin.

b309d50633 adds the incremental branch 'if let Some(mutations)' in code_split with no check that the splitter cache is populated; 04ab20e0c5 adds the module_ordinal.is_empty() check. Needs the persistent-cache restore path. I did not check that the restore path existed at intro.

34d29bdc1a adds OriginalSource (for the rsdoctor JSON-size feature) and aeea1a8c75 reverts it 'to match webpack'. The effect is source-map content, not a wrong result or crash; the diff doesn't show that the devtool plugin emits every OriginalSource.
6913e4dd11 adds exports_fields: Some(vec![vec!["export"]]) in Helper::new; 084d4e6f14 changes it to "exports". Local typo, visible in the diff.

06b23afc1d adds DependencyConditionFn::handle_composed (default primary+rest) and DependencyCondition::Composed; b2df399f7f removes both. Needs the semantics of ConnectionState addition across condition sites. Intro is 66 files, +1268, so it is large but within the limit.

6d92edd640 adds try_returns = matches!(t, ScopeTerminated::Return) in walk_try_statement; 21e4aa12ee drops it. The comment 'If try block returns we never run the catch' asserts the wrong premise rather than naming a defect. Local to one function.

fe27990c98 adds connection_active_for_esm_import_specifier returning true on impure deferred pure checks before the inline-value check; 4fde2fb00d moves the inline check first. Needs the inline-value condition, a second site.

The unconditional merge_runtime in the roots.get_mut(&block_id) branch already existed at cdaf9ad7ad^; the intro adds the named_roots branch with the same merge. Fix f21abc7ce8 patches both. The defect is only partly introduced by cdaf9ad7ad.

Later commits (b2df399f7f, 23ec7acf0f and others in a4e52902d7..4799b513d4) rewrote the check before 4799b513d4 replaced it. The introducing change is a later commit.

3d387eefd3 adds pre_declarator calling parser.tag_variable(...) with no define_variable; 15732646f4 adds define_variable first. Needs the tag_variable contract (it mutates an enclosing definition).

That is visible in the diff, but the title says redirects to other URLs were intended, and the fix cites a later webpack security fix. Intended behavior versus defect is ambiguous.

The comment 'no rendering is performed here' documents the assumption rather than naming the defect. Needs the template/placeholder semantics.
